reviews.comment: Definitely a hard class, but Dr. Korty made the material easy to understand. He was always very willing to give extra help when needed, and also recorded the lectures so students were able to go back and rewatch them which was a tremendous help.

Had Dr. Korty for 201 and 435, amazing both times. Incredibly nice guy and will help if you need it. Made dynamics easy for me personally. Exam averages were usually a C, so I'd recommend rewatching lectures if possible (I did this and got A's on the exams). No final, which was nice.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Korty was a pretty good prof for this class. He has a tendency to skip over menial things in his notes (assuming we're following), which was quite the contrast to my dynamics I prof who wrote everything word for word. He's super helpful if you reach out to him for clarification on lecture notes or for homework. Tests are a bit hard for 50 min.
